source_authority: United States Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services

reviewed_sources.claim: CMS publishes FOIA-disclosable NPPES provider data on the Internet without a download charge.
CMS states that the downloadable CSV is intended for import into a relational database or other technical manipulation.
CMS publishes the current monthly replacement and weekly incremental Version 2 archive links.

limits: This review is an internal technical provenance artifact, not a CMS signature or legal opinion.
Artifact hashes prove byte identity, not CMS authorship or authenticity.
The phase-one evidence replay covers the primary NPI CSV member, not every auxiliary ZIP member semantic.
For sparse deactivated rows, only the NPI and deactivation date may be source-supported; no entity type may be inferred.
Issuance of an NPI does not establish licensure or credentialing.
Serving, publication, redistribution, and export authority remain disabled.
